sections.title: Parcel summary handler
sections.what: Returns the parcel summary for a case, or a not-found response if none exists.
sections.why: Gives the parcel panel one place to read from.
sections.watch_out: No catch around the service call, so service failures are not handled here.

summary: Web address that returns the parcel summary, including geometry and area comparisons, for one case.
purpose: Supplies the parcel panel with consistent numbers.
why: Likely reason: all parcel numbers come from one service, so the page stays consistent.
how: Reads the case id, asks the parcel service for the summary, and returns it. If there is none, returns a 404 with code PARCEL_NOT_FOUND.
outputs: JSON with a data field, or a 404 with a parcel-specific message.
risks: Unexpected service errors are not caught in this file.
debug: A 404 means the service has no parcel information for the case. New cases are expected to return an empty geometry rather than a 404, according to the tests.
